paragraphs.source_en:
I sate down to write some words for an ariette which might be profane —. But it was
in vain to struggle with the ruling spirit, who compelled me to speak of things sacred to
yours & Wilhelmeister’s indulgence —. I commit them to your secrecy & your mercy &
will try & do better another time.
